<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA has to address Vertex Networks one-to-many with Maple & Crown and NovaComm one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a separate Vertex Networks GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Separate NovaComm GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a single NexusLink application that addresses OptiWave, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Travis McCullough <travis.mccullough@maplecrown.ca>
Sent: Tuesday, 9 July 2024 8:33 PM
To: Lee Mills <lee.mills@maplecrown.ca>, Nicholas Porter <nicholas.porter@maplecrown.ca>, John Cummings <john.cummings@maplecrown.ca>, Bradley Miller <bradley.miller@maplecrown.ca>, Douglas Dixon <douglas.dixon@maplecrown.ca>, Harry M Collins <harry.collins@maplecrown.ca>, Sandra Wood <sandra.wood@maplecrown.ca>
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA omitting the distinction between transactions on NovaComm and transactions on Vertex Networks. If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post product on NovaComm, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" matching site. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on NovaComm, since the products transacted on NovaComm are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard GTCs.
